thread:
Ari (marketing): Devon just flagged a partial degradation in us-east for streaming responses. Need quick alignment: when do we post status, when do we email, and what wording is allowed (no benchmarks or promo).
Devon (ops): Aim to post an "investigating" within 5-8m. Email if sustained >40m. For partial degradations (errors + retries), we prefer a targeted email only to affected customers, not broad broadcast.
Pri (support): Support needs a one-line subject + 2-sentence body and short canned Slack replies. Also confirm whether we should mention retry/backoff guidance in the initial email.
Hannah (product): Recommend including a line for customers using long-streaming sessions: "you may see interrupted streams; reconnect will resume from last token". Also send us the pinned-model list so CS can prioritize.
Eloise (growth): Confirmed: no marketing content in incident emails. Social: only a link to status if public email goes out. If it's targeted only, no social.
Ari (marketing): Draft statuscopy below (please edit):
```
We're aware of an issue affecting streaming responses in us-east. Some customers may experience interrupted streams or increased latency. Our engineers are investigating and working to restore normal service. Suggested action: retry failed streams; for long-running sessions reconnect. Next update: within 30 minutes.
```
Devon (ops): That reads well. Ops will add an ETA only if we have a validated remediation timeline. We'll send signal "ops:email-targeted" when we hit 40m with list of affected orgs.
Pri (support): I'll prepare canned replies (micro + expanded) and a plain-text email template for targeted sends. Micro subject suggestion: "Redwood: Interruption affecting streaming in us-east".
Hannah (product): I'll DM the list of pinned-model customers to Pri and Ari. Also adding a short note about private deployments (likely unaffected) to the draft.
